purpose: Supplementary conservative cost comparison after one fixed-tariff response timeout. Exact primary cost metrics remain unknown.
method: In every connected-group bootstrap draw assign all baseline unknown requests their lower cost bound and all candidate unknown requests their upper bound. This upper-bounds the candidate/baseline cost-per-correct ratio even when the unknown request is shared. Never call either bound a measured charge.
reporting: Report primary unknown cost, known-plus-reserved total exposure, exact unchanged recognition/safety metrics, and the worst-case sensitivity interval separately. No omitted case, zero-cost imputation or source-specific tuning.
original_attempted_failure: Retained as failed; only zero-dispatch records resume.
